image_description: A low-angle shot of a street sign assembly against a clear blue sky. The assembly consists of two rectangular black street name signs mounted on top of a circular white regulatory sign with a black border and a black arrow symbol pointing right. The signs are mounted on a dark vertical post. Text on the street signs appears to be in Hebrew.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the upper street signs resembles Hebrew script but exhibits slight character deformation and inconsistent kerning. Some characters appear to merge or have irregular stroke widths, suggesting AI generation artifacts rather than crisp printed typography.

artifact_observations.location: Junction of rectangular signs and circular sign
artifact_observations.reasoning: The mounting hardware connecting the top rectangular signs to the post/circular sign assembly is slightly ambiguous. The brackets seem to float or merge slightly with the background of the circular sign, lacking precise mechanical clarity.
